newsitem.title: CHILE: PP&L to buy stake in Chile's Empresas Emel.
newsitem.headline: PP&L to buy stake in Chile's Empresas Emel.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Resources (PP&L) agreed to buy a 25 percent stake in Empresas Emel SA for $106 million, the Chilean electricity distributor said on Monday.
The U.S. power company will buy new shares in Emel to be created in April, Emel said in a statement.
After the deal's completion, the companies will implement a $480 million investment plan, involving projects in Chile and the rest of Latin America.

"Both companies' strategic plans have as their objective an aggressive program of investments in electricity companies in Chile and the rest of Latin America over the next five years," said the statement.
Emel is looking in the short term at the sale of power utilities in Buenos Aires and Mendoza in Argentina and Arequipa in Peru.
The company, Chile's third-largest power distributor, is also interested in investing in Colombia and Ecuador.
Emel operates regional electricity utilities in northern and sourthern Chile and owns a power company in Cochabamba, Bolivia.
